name: Caustic Fumes
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level bloodlord 3, death mage 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, unchained summoner 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (powdered peas and an animal hoof)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect fog spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high
Duration 1 round/2 levels
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as fog cloud except the mist is caustic and deals 1d6 acid damage to any creature entering or beginning their turn in its area.

Additionally, the fumes burn the eyes and impose a -5 penalty to vision-based Perception checks while in the area and for 2 rounds thereafter.
